title: When Corpus Coverage Matters More Than Model Choice: An English-Uzbek Low-Resource RAG Evaluation Dataset
description: Auxiliary draft metadata for a prepared 400-item English-Uzbek retrieval evaluation benchmark. The public branch currently includes only a preview sample without gold_answer fields while full release clearance is pending.
limitations: Retrieval-side benchmark only; not a full generated-answer quality benchmark.
Full raw corpora, indexes, and HPC run artifacts are not included in this release folder.
English supplementation results are retracted and should not be cited.
